parameters.name: Enable
parameters.description: Enables or disables this MAC address to be allowed to connect to the MoCA network.

parameters.name: MACAddress
parameters.description: If {{param|#.AccessControlEnable}} is set to {{true}}, MoCA Node with this MAC address is allowed to join the MoCA network. It is not guaranteed that the MoCA Node with this MAC address can form or join a network.

object.description: MoCA interface MAC access control table. This table contains a list of MAC addresses that are allowed to connect to the MoCA network. In addition to being in this access control list, a MoCA Node must have the proper {{param|#.FreqCurrentMask}}, {{param|#.PrivacyEnabledSetting}}, and {{param|#.KeyPassphrase}} before the MoCA Node can form or join a MoCA network.
